description.value: Vallea Lumina is an immersive multimedia night walk through the forest on Cougar Mountain, blending lighting installations, soundscapes, and interactive storytelling along a designated trail. Operated by The Adventure Group, the experience runs year-round after sunset and follows either a 1 km winter course or a 1.5 km summer course through the forest. A free bookable shuttle connects Whistler Village Gateway Bus Loop to the Cougar Mountain basecamp, making it accessible without a vehicle.

address.value: Sixteen Mile Creek Forest Service Road, Whistler, BC V0N 1B8

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website provides rich detail about Vallea Lumina as an evening multimedia trail experience on Cougar Mountain, with transport options described as shuttle, taxi, and car — no mention of bike parking, bike racks, washrooms, water, or any cyclist-specific amenities. Contact details (phone, address) come entirely from the website since OSM tags contain no address or phone. The attraction is a legitimate Whistler tourism offering that a cycling visitor would plausibly want to attend as an evening activity.

The venue is located on a forest service road 15 minutes north of Whistler Village; cyclists arriving by bike would need to navigate an unmarked forest road with no confirmed bike infrastructure at the destination.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Vallea Lumina is a well-established, actively operating Whistler attraction that touring cyclists staying in the area would plausibly seek out as an evening activity; the free village shuttle makes it accessible without a car.
